coordinate_space.notes: Image-space pixel coordinates for CAM-01's actual video feed (data/demo/emergency_scene.mp4, 720x1280 portrait). Polygons below were calibrated against the real scene and the observed spatial distribution of real detections — they are human-curated for this one camera view, not inferred at runtime. If the camera or its resolution changes, these polygons must be re-calibrated; RESQ does not rescale them automatically.
